from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
from fractions import Fraction
from decimal import Decimal,localcontext
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from itertools import product
import json,subprocess,tempfile,traceback
import mpmath as mp
folder=Path(tempfile.gettempdir());mf=folder/'s169bh-closeout.json';meta=json.loads(mf.read_bytes())
root=Path(meta['satellite_root']);stem='current-smeared-heat-projection-domain'
receipt=json.loads((root/'evidence'/f'{stem}.json').read_bytes());run=receipt['runs'][-1]
evfile=root/'evidence'/f'{stem}-closeout-verification.json';ev=json.loads(evfile.read_bytes()) if evfile.exists() else {'attempts':[]}
attempt={'started_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'source_utf8':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'),'source_sha256':sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
def bounds(x):
 a=x['decimal_enclosure'];u=Fraction(10)**int(a['exponent']);m=Fraction(a['mid'])*u;r=Fraction(a['rad'])*u
 return m-r,m,m+r
def fm(f):return mp.mpf(f.numerator)/f.denominator
def mm(x,i=1):return fm(bounds(x)[i])
def inside(v,x):return mm(x,0)<=v<=mm(x,2)
def out(v,up=True):
 with localcontext() as c:
  c.prec=8;c.rounding='ROUND_CEILING' if up else 'ROUND_FLOOR';return str(+Decimal(str(v)))
try:
 assert run['status']=='passed' and all(x['passed'] for x in run['checks'])
 assert run['input_sha256_before']==run['input_sha256_after']
 assert all(sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for p,h in run['input_sha256_after'].items())
 for kind in ['planning','satellite']:
  rr=Path(meta[kind+'_root'])
  assert all(sha256((rr/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for p,h in meta[kind+'_inherited'].items())
  assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=rr,text=True).strip()==meta[kind+'_previous_commit']
  assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached','--name-only'],cwd=rr).strip()
 mp.mp.dps=90
 # Direct index contractions of the universal pure-metric cubic a6 terms.
 delta=lambda i,j:int(i==j)
 ric=lambda i,j:Fraction(delta(i,j),2)
 riem=lambda i,j,k,l:Fraction(delta(i,l)*delta(j,k)-delta(i,k)*delta(j,l),2)
 inds=range(2);ric2=sum(ric(i,j)**2 for i,j in product(inds,repeat=2));rr2=sum(riem(*p)**2 for p in product(inds,repeat=4))
 trric3=sum(ric(j,k)*ric(j,n)*ric(k,n) for j,k,n in product(inds,repeat=3))
 t4=sum(ric(i,j)*ric(k,l)*riem(i,k,j,l) for i,j,k,l in product(inds,repeat=4))
 t5=sum(ric(j,k)*riem(j,n,l,i)*riem(k,n,l,i) for j,k,n,l,i in product(inds,repeat=5))
 t6=sum(riem(i,j,k,n)*riem(i,j,l,p)*riem(k,n,l,p) for i,j,k,n,l,p in product(inds,repeat=6))
 t7=sum(riem(i,j,k,n)*riem(i,l,k,p)*riem(j,l,n,p) for i,j,k,n,l,p in product(inds,repeat=6))
 metric=2*(Fraction(35,9)-Fraction(14,3)*ric2+Fraction(14,3)*rr2-Fraction(208,9)*trric3-Fraction(64,3)*t4-Fraction(16,3)*t5-Fraction(44,9)*t6-Fraction(80,9)*t7)/5040
 assert metric==Fraction(1,315),str(metric)
 I=mp.eye(2);zero=mp.matrix([[0,0],[0,0]]);J=mp.matrix([[0,1],[-1,0]])
 Om=lambda i,j:(J/4 if (i,j)==(0,1) else -J/4 if (i,j)==(1,0) else zero)
 trace=lambda A:A[0,0]+A[1,1]
 E=-I/4
 so=sum((Om(i,j)*Om(i,j) for i,j in product(inds,repeat=2)),zero)
 omega3=sum((Om(i,j)*Om(j,k)*Om(k,i) for i,j,k in product(inds,repeat=3)),zero)
 curvOm=sum((fm(riem(i,j,k,n))*Om(i,j)*Om(k,n) for i,j,k,n in product(inds,repeat=4)),zero)
 ricOm=sum((fm(ric(j,k))*Om(j,n)*Om(k,n) for j,k,n in product(inds,repeat=3)),zero)
 spin=trace(-12*omega3-6*curvOm-4*ricOm+5*so+60*E**3+30*E*so+30*E**2+5*E-2*E*fm(ric2)+2*E*fm(rr2))/360
 assert abs(spin+mp.mpf(1)/240)<mp.mpf('1e-85')
 assert abs(fm(metric)+spin+mp.mpf(1)/1008)<mp.mpf('1e-85')
 data=next(x for x in run['numerics'] if x['kind']=='a6_actual_pair_envelope')
 seed=next(x for x in run['numerics'] if x['kind']=='actual_seed_correlated_endpoint')
 def add(*ps):
  outp=[mp.mpf(0)]*max(len(p) for p in ps)
  for p in ps:
   for i,x in enumerate(p):outp[i]+=x
  return outp
 def sc(p,a):return [x*a for x in p]
 def diff(p):return [i*p[i] for i in range(1,len(p))] or [mp.mpf(0)]
 def mul(p,q):
  rr=[mp.mpf(0)]*(len(p)+len(q)-1)
  for i,a in enumerate(p):
   for j,b in enumerate(q):rr[i+j]+=a*b
  return rr
 def val(p,z):return mp.polyval(list(reversed(p)),z)
 Q=[mp.mpf(0)]*7
 for k,a in zip([0,2,3,4,5,6],seed['Q_coefficients']):Q[k]=mm(a)
 R=sc(diff(diff(Q)),-1);D=lambda p:diff(mul(Q,diff(p)));L=lambda p:add(D(p),mul(R,p))
 v=[mp.mpf(0)]*4+[mp.mpf(-1)];dR=D(R);R2=mul(R,R);R3=mul(R2,R)
 O=sc(add(L(D(L(v))),mul(dR,L(v)),D(mul(v,dR))),-mp.mpf(1)/105)
 O=add(O,sc(add(sc(mul(R3,v),16),sc(mul(R2,D(v)),24),sc(D(mul(R2,v)),24),sc(D(mul(R,D(v))),24)),-mp.mpf(1)/1008),sc(v,mp.mpf(4)/63))
 Op=diff(O)
 assert len(O)==len(data['O_coefficients'])
 for i,x in enumerate(O):assert inside(x,data['O_coefficients'][i]),i
 for i,x in enumerate(Op):assert inside(x,data['Oprime_coefficients'][i]),i
 A=mp.mpf('3.768e-12');al=mp.mpf('4e-28');f0=mp.mpf('4.34e-11');sr=mm(data['s0']);zc=1-mp.mpf(2)**-49
 ell=lambda z:-mp.log1p(-z)-z
 envelope=lambda z:((A*ell(z)+al)*abs(val(O,z))/2+(z*(1-z)*(A*ell(z)+f0+al)+sr*z*z/2)*abs(val(Op,z)))/(4*mp.pi)
 # Finite quadrature is an independent diagnostic; interval cell proof remains authoritative.
 nodes=[zc*mp.mpf(i)/64 for i in range(65)]
 integral=mp.quad(envelope,nodes)
 assert mm(data['bulk_envelope_lower'],0)<=integral<=mm(data['bulk_envelope_upper'],2)
 cells=data['cells'];assert len(cells)==256
 for i,c in enumerate(cells):
  assert inside(zc*i/256,c['lo']) and inside(zc*(i+1)/256,c['hi'])
 lower=sum((mm(c['lower']) for c in cells),mp.mpf(0));upper=sum((mm(c['upper']) for c in cells),mp.mpf(0))
 assert abs(lower-mm(data['bulk_envelope_lower']))<mp.mpf('1e-65')
 assert abs(upper-mm(data['bulk_envelope_upper']))<mp.mpf('1e-65')
 endpoint=zc*zc*abs(val(O,zc))*(sr+2*(1-zc)/zc*(A*ell(zc)+f0+al))/(8*mp.pi)
 assert inside(endpoint,data['endpoint_allowance'])
 U=mm(data['U6'],2);B2=mm(data['B_squared']);C=mm(data['C']);Fl=mm(data['F_lambda']);t0=mp.mpf('.001')
 Dt=mp.mpf('2.5e-43')*B2*Fl/(4*C)
 cap=4*C*mm(data['U6'])*t0/(B2*Fl)
 capacity=2*(Dt-mm(data['U6'])*t0)/(t0*t0)
 assert inside(Dt,data['Dtarget']) and inside(cap,data['leading_cap_allowance']) and inside(capacity,data['required_B_heat_upper'])
 assert capacity>0
 result=dict(U6_upper=out(U),leading_cap_upper=out(mm(data['leading_cap_allowance'],2)),
  B_heat_sufficient=out(mm(data['required_B_heat_upper'],0),False),
  Dtarget_sufficient=out(mm(data['Dtarget'],0),False),positive_envelope_quadrature=mp.nstr(integral,60),
  bulk_envelope_lower=out(mm(data['bulk_envelope_lower'],0),False),bulk_envelope_upper=out(mm(data['bulk_envelope_upper'],2)),
  endpoint_upper=out(mm(data['endpoint_allowance'],2)),omitted_interval_upper=out(mm(data['omitted_interval_allowance'],2)),
  cells=len(cells),universal_cubic_metric_coefficient=str(metric),universal_cubic_spin_coefficient='-1/240',
  selected_mixed_regulator_limit_scope='Ordinary smearing/actual smooth-test half-domain argument only.',
  quantitative_full_heat_remainder_known=False,full_heat_cap_certified=False,complete_projection_evaluated=False,
  C2_action_on_rough_base_family_proved=False,nonlinear_solution_certified=False)
 frozen={p:sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in run['frozen_sources_utf8']}
 meta.update(checks=len(run['checks']),inputs=len(run['input_sha256_after']),runs=len(receipt['runs']),
  failed_runs=sum(x['status']!='passed' for x in receipt['runs']),json_rows=len((root/'evidence'/f'{stem}.log').read_text().splitlines()),
  scientific_frozen_sha256=frozen,independent_result=result)
 mf.write_text(json.dumps(meta,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
 attempt.update(status='passed',results=result,scientific_source_hashes=frozen,
  scope='Independent universal cubic tensor contractions, polynomial operator construction, positive-envelope quadrature, exact coverage, cell summation and physical cap/capacity arithmetic. Not a checker proof of the heat parametrix argument.')
except Exception:attempt.update(status='failed',exception=traceback.format_exc())
attempt['finished_utc']=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat();ev['attempts'].append(attempt)
evfile.write_text(json.dumps(ev,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({k:attempt[k] for k in ['status','results','exception'] if k in attempt}),flush=True)
if attempt['status']!='passed':raise SystemExit(1)
